notes.title: New Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Everyone!
We had all your concern,  around us removing our survival mode and replace with another horde mode also changed the whole concept of the game, however there's certain things we'd like to announce.

-	The current version of the game isn’t the finish product, It’s just another mode to keep you waiting before big incoming patch
-	The Big incoming patch was the reason we took out survival mode, It was to re-work after we gained all your feedback from alpha test, we decided to drop down many things and shift the focus into creating campaign story mode mainly
-	We are sorry for not communicate well with community because we had nothing better to say than to finish the upcoming patch and make our fans appreciate once for all
-	
We must apologize for keep our fans waiting for too long due to many issues we facing but the game is still in-development so please chin up and have some (Black) Faith!
Developers,
